scenario: cacheFile target escaping the tool folder
reason: CacheFile strips leading '..' and '.' segments from the target so that a target can never be written outside the tool folder; @actions/tool-cache joins the path verbatim and writes ../escaped.txt next to the architecture folder. Deliberate hardening, kept.

CacheOptions.Tool is validated and an error is returned; @actions/tool-cache accepts '' and caches straight into the root of the tool cache. Kept: the Go options struct makes an unset field indistinguishable from an empty one.
